title: crataegus oxyacantha f. paulii
intro: Crataegus oxyacantha f. paulii, commonly known as English Hawthorn Paul's Variety, is a specific cultivar of the hawthorn plant species. It is a deciduous shrub or small tree native to Europe, known for its medicinal properties and ornamental value. The plant has been traditionally used for its health benefits, including reducing blood pressure and alleviating symptoms of heart failure, due to its therapeutic actions such as vasodilation and cardiac glycoside activity. The bioactive constituents of English Hawthorn Paul's Variety include flavonoids, oligomeric proanthocyanidins (OPCs), and triterpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal effects.
